name: 希尔巴贡
title: 刚力怪兽
text:
生活在伴随彩虹出现、被称作日本百慕大三角的异空间，性格凶猛，银色皮肤坚硬、力大而视力很差，只能看见移动的东西。它打破嘎地II的屏障并击败它，随后与被困在异空间的大古变成的迪迦交战，最后被强力型迪迦的燃烧冲击击败。

身高：65米。体重：75,000吨。
version_scope: 仅迪迦原版希尔巴贡；嘎地II是交战对象，不是构成或形态，不借银龙王等后作。
source_label: 圆谷官方本人图鉴（简体中文整理）

fact_sources.original_description: This Herculean monster lives in a place known as “Japan’s Bermuda Triangle,” a mysterious realm that appeared alongside a rainbow. It has a cruel and ferocious personality, and is covered in tough, silver skin. It possesses immense strength but has poor eyesight and can only see moving things. As it was attacking a car of people that happened to be lost in the area, Barrier Monster Gagi II entered the fray. Silvergon broke a hole in its barrier and began to fight. After tearing off Gagi II’s arms, it used them to restrain it and ripped open its throat with its teeth. Daigo Madoka of GUTS, who had also become trapped in the mysterious realm, transformed into Ultraman Tiga. It looked as if Silvergon would win at first, but things turned around after Horii told Tiga of its weak point. Finally, Tiga transformed into Power Type and defeated the monster with Tiga Burning Dash.
